traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet. This combination is modern/cyclic only.

modern.blend: Identity meets independence and disruption. The urge to be different and to do things your own way.
modern.harmonious: Originality that reads as brilliance or healthy independence.
modern.hard: Difference for its own sake: eccentricity, instability, shocking people to no purpose.
modern.business: Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
